'''Lariss''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Major/Legends|major]].

==Biography==
[[Major/Legends|Major]] Lariss was a career [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], specializing in swift takeovers of indigenous [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lariss was sent to subjugate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]], and decide on the fate of the ruling [[Rajah]] and his [[Royal Court]]; house arrest, exile to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]], or [[Death/Legends|death]]. Unknown to him, the Rajah and his Court had been tipped off by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and replaced with an Alliance team that were purposely trying to get sent to Captivity to enact a rescue plan on imprisoned [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and [[Politics/Legends|political]] prisoners. Lariss obliged them after they manipulated and angered him into exiling them.

==Personality and traits==
Lariss was sensitive about his appearance, and possessed a rather large nose. Alliance agents familiar with the Major referred to him as "Major Nose," or "hangar nose;" this information had found its way to Lariss' attention and infuriated him. Lariss was a no-nonsense officer, who looked down on the locals he was sent to subjugate as lesser beings. Despite have only a superficial knowledge of the worlds he subjugated, Lariss believed himself to be an expert on them.<ref name="FTF" />

==Skills and abilities==
Lariss was trained in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], as well as [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] combat. He had a passing knowledge of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their cultures, despite his belief he was an expert.<ref name="FTF" />

==Equipment==
Lariss carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and an [[Iajik whip]], a souvenir he had acquired during a previous campaign.<ref name="FTF" />
